name: stxt
description: Language support for STXT: highlighting, validation against schemas and templates, completion, hover and formatting.

semanticTokenTypes.description: Heading line inside a MARKDOWN block
Bold text inside a MARKDOWN block
Italic text inside a MARKDOWN block
Inline code or fenced code inside a MARKDOWN block
List item marker inside a MARKDOWN block
Block quote marker inside a MARKDOWN block
Link or image inside a MARKDOWN block

stxt.schemaValidation.description: Validate documents against the schemas and templates found through the resolution chain (STXT-DISCOVERY-SPEC). A namespace no definition covers is reported as SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND, also when the chain has no definition at all. Off: only the syntax is checked.

stxt.developerMode.description: Show the technical details of the node under the cursor in the hover: form and level, canonical and qualified names, value, schema type and allowed values, text content, and comments. When off, the hover shows only the description the schema or template gives for the node, if there is one.

stxt.maxNesting.description: Maximum open nesting levels of the parser (STXT-SPEC 11.2); level 0 is the first. A document nesting deeper is rejected with LIMIT_NESTING_EXCEEDED. -1 disables the limit; 100 is the recommended default.

stxt.maxLineLength.description: Maximum length of one line, indentation included (STXT-SPEC 11.2). A longer line is rejected with LIMIT_LINE_LENGTH_EXCEEDED. -1 disables the limit; 10000 is the recommended default.

stxt.maxInputSize.description: Maximum total size of a document, in characters (STXT-SPEC 11.2). A larger document is rejected with LIMIT_INPUT_SIZE_EXCEEDED. -1 disables the limit; 10000000 is the recommended default.
